facts.assertion: Two independent experimental methods (in vitro cleavage and IDLV) reported a total of 12 heterodimeric bona fide off-target sites for the CCR5 ZFNs.
facts.sirnaforge_mapping: Assert known validated-site panel appears in top-N once per-site sequence/coordinates are ingested.

facts.assertion: Using PROGNOS Homology/Conserved G's and analyzing top 3× the number of sites interrogated by Pattanayak et al., PROGNOS could predict 10 out of 12 bona fide off-target sites.
facts.sirnaforge_mapping: Use majority-recovery regression threshold once golden-site coordinates/sequences are available.

facts.assertion: A novel CCR5 ZFN off-target site near CSNK1G3 was experimentally validated by interrogating predicted sites not found by other methods.
facts.sirnaforge_mapping: Assert CSNK1G3-near site presence/ranking once supplementary per-site records are ingested.

facts.assertion: If two sites have equal algorithm scores, PROGNOS tie-breaks by region Exon > Promoter > Intron > Intergenic, then chromosomal location.
facts.sirnaforge_mapping: Future rank_sites() should apply this tie-break policy when score ties occur.

facts.assertion: Site sequences are represented as 5′—(+) half-site—spacer—(–) half-site—3′; for ZFNs the (+) half-site is listed reverse anti-sense relative to bound DNA strand.
facts.sirnaforge_mapping: Use canonical sequence/orientation convention for ZFNOffTargetSite.sequence, MatchOrientation, and spacer_len derivation.
